title: Culture Affordance Atlas: Reconciling Object Diversity Through Functional Mapping

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance disparities by measuring zero-shot image retrieval recall and CLIP text-image alignment scores across images grouped by household income quartiles and bins using the Dollar Street dataset.

Assessing the representation and misclassification of culturally specific, non-Western household objects (long-tail artifacts) across major vision-language datasets, and evaluating how function-centric versus standard object-centric prompts affect the retrieval of these diverse cultural artifacts.
